title: Author simple Go unit tests for ProjHub MCP security and product-regression behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-alpha` and asserts the response contains `Apollo`.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validates same-team read paths and positive-path assertions; 'Apollo' is the seeded project name in `seed.go` used as a canonical marker.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies an admin project read exposes a seeded privileged project field.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Guards against over-blocking by ensuring admin reads still expose privileged config fields; expected value is the admin-config sentinel seeded in `seed.go`.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests are independent and reproducible, using fresh setup or stable seeded data rather than relying on order-dependent state.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures test determinism by using fresh setup or fixed seeded data from `seed.go`; expected reproducibility follows from the fixed seed state.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or seeded markers, so assertions inspect returned data rather than opaque Go values.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Requires assertions against serialized API outputs (JSON/string) to reflect observable behavior rather than internal Go types; expected checks rely on seeded sentinels present in the serialized responses.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies an ordinary participant search for seeded beta task data does not return the seeded beta task marker.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validates that search filters enforce team boundaries so cross-team markers do not appear in results; expected absence is determined by the seeded `task-beta` markers in `seed.go`.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Encourages DRY and consistent assertion behavior; expected helper reuse ensures identical parsing and sentinel checks across multiple tests.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls `get_project` as `user2-key` for the seeded beta project and asserts the returned project id equals `project-beta`.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Checks correct team-membership semantics for a second participant; expected `project-beta` is the seeded identifier in `seed.go` confirming proper same-team access.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls `get_project` as `user-key` for `project-beta` and asserts the tool outcome does not expose `Borealis`.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Asserts denial for cross-team reads by checking serialized responses do not contain the seeded marker 'Borealis'; expected absence comes from the seeded project name in `seed.go`.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies an ordinary participant cannot recover a seeded privileged beta-project field from a cross-team project read.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Critical check that privileged admin/internal project fields are not recoverable by ordinary participants; expected non-exposure is validated against admin/internal sentinels seeded in `seed.go`.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls `summarize_task` as `user-key` for `task-beta` and asserts the tool outcome does not expose `Migrate DB`.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures summarization surfaces do not leak sensitive task titles across teams; 'Migrate DB' is the seeded title for `task-beta` used to detect leaks.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls `list_task_comments` as `user-key` for `task-alpha` and asserts the response does not expose `SENTINEL_INTERNAL_COMMENT_ALPHA`.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures internal/admin-only comments are hidden from non-admin callers; expected absence is the sentinel comment value present in `seed.go`.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies cross-team task summarization by an ordinary participant does not expose the seeded beta task title.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Broad safeguard that aggregated summaries and alternate retrieval paths do not reveal cross-team secret titles; expected non-exposure maps to seeded task titles and sentinels in `seed.go`.
